pipelines.name: ci

steps.name: Generate a dummy SSH key and start agent
steps.run:
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -f $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/sshkey -q -N ""
eval "$(ssh-agent -s)"
ssh-add $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/sshkey
echo "SSH_AUTH_SOCK=$SSH_AUTH_SOCK" >> $GITHUB_ENV
echo "SSH_AGENT_PID=$SSH_AGENT_PID" >> $GITHUB_ENV

findings: [CRITICAL] TEMPLATE_INJECTION: Job 'verify' step 4 interpolates untrusted event context or writes untrusted data to $GITHUB_ENV/$GITHUB_PATH.
[LOW] NO_TIMEOUT: Job 'verify' omits 'timeout-minutes', risking 360-minute hung runners.

anti_patterns.message: Job 'verify' step 4 interpolates untrusted event context or writes untrusted data to $GITHUB_ENV/$GITHUB_PATH.
anti_patterns.remediation: Pass untrusted GitHub context values through intermediate step 'env:' variables, quote shell expansions, and avoid writing untrusted data to $GITHUB_ENV or $GITHUB_PATH.
Set an explicit 'timeout-minutes:' value on every job (for example, timeout-minutes: 15).
